Resume the conversation a DSH restart interrupted — so you never have to type "继续" again.
中文说明
## The problem
DeepSeek Harness persists every session to disk, so the conversation history survives a restart. The
**turn that was running** does not: on resume, `interruptedTurnClosers()` appends a synthetic `turn
/end { reason: { kind: 'interrupted' } }` that closes the open turn, and the session then waits for
your next message. Restart during work and the agent simply stops mid-thought.
## What this does
One check, once per host boot (`delayMs` after activation):

1. List the stored sessions of every workspace.
2. Read the tail of each one and look for an *unfini

shed turn*:
- the last event is `turn/start` with no `turn/end` — the process died mid-turn, or
- th

e last `turn/end` carries `reason.kind === 'interrupted'` — the marker a later resume wrote.
3. For
every session that matches, `agents.resume()` it (or reuse the already-registered agent) and `agent.
followup()` a short user message — `继续` by default.
Nothing else in DSH is touched: no schema, no patch to core, no extra process.
### What it deliberately does NOT resume
| Last turn ended with | Why it is skipped |

| `reason.kind === 'user'` | you pressed Stop — resuming would fight you |
| `reason.kind === 'compl

eted'` | the turn finished normally |
| a turn older than `maxAgeHours` | stale, likely abandoned on

he turn finished normally |
| a turn older than `maxAgeHours` | stale, likely abandoned on purpose |
An agent instance that is already `running` for that session is also skipped, so a UI that reopened
the conversation first always wins.
### Guards against a crash loop
If the resumed turn crashes the host again, the next boot would resume it again — forever. Two limit
ed turn crashes the host again, the next boot would resume it again — forever. Two limits stop that:

- `cooldownMinutes` — at most one automatic resume per session in that window;
- `maxPerDay` — a har
d cap per session per 24 hours.
`maxResumePerBoot` and `staggerMs` keep a busy machine from starting five model turns at the same in
sumePerBoot` and `staggerMs` keep a busy machine from starting five model turns at the same instant.

`state.json` in the same directory holds the per-session cooldown history (delete it to clear).
## How the tail is read
`sessionPersistence.open(id, 'read')` + a bounded `read()` starting from the last projected seq (up
to 1000 events back), falling back to a full read when the projection cache is missing or the window
holds no turn boundary. Sessions are resolved from the workspace registry, so subagent and archived
sessions never become candidates.

- DSH host `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`
